notes: PT/TT & noi soi: noi soi thoi bi coi la phuong phap dieu tri — XML3 het khai vo cam va gio mo muon cua ca mo khac cung luot; hang doi PT/TT, the thong ke, man Y lenh va bang B.3 benh an nay cung mot truc voi cong tao ca. Tuong trinh PT/TT in du ten e-kip (9 o, truoc chi 3). Xoa chi dinh nay don luon ban in cua chung tu quanh ca mo — het phieu rac dong o man Ky so tap trung. Rule BHYT thoi bat oan: R055 (noi tru vao-ra cung ngay), R046 (han the theo NGAY), R240/R241 (khong ap khung gio lam viec cho ho so noi tru), R245/R108/R153/R152/R039, R246; XML3 nhom 10 (VTYT) thoi muon NGAY_KQ cua phieu khac; canh bao ro khi ma bac si dong tien giuong khong tra duoc. Bao cao: bao cao thuoc va bao cao chan doan phong loc theo NGAY NGHIEP VU thay vi gio bam luu — het canh chay ky thang truoc ra 0 dong. Tiep don: chup quyen loi the ngay tai tiep don, chan resync ghi de ho so da nop cong. Cham soc dieu duong & benh an: phieu 38/BV1 co 107 ma can thiep dieu duong, cat trang theo moc, moi to du khung thong tin; benh an RHM ngoai tru MS 16/BV-01 du o nhap; o ma ICD in nguyen ma tren 9 mau benh an.
